Derived = 5,885,691 / 16. Cross-check: S/E Las Dichas 66/12 kV 30 MVA + 6 feeder bays + line sectioning = 10,286,476 USD (342,883 USD/MVA), same document Tabla 4-1.

items.note: Derived from ITP v2 Tablas 4-2, 4-3, 5-1. Range across 12 ATD: 4.6 % (ATD1) to 29.6 % (ATD9); includes administration, not pure network O&M.

items.orig_unit: MM CLP Dec-2022: [VNR quality, VNR base]
items.note: Benchmark: extra investment to meet NTD reliability, dense urban vs rural.
ITP v2 Tabla 8-1, whole-distribution-system VAD per kW of peak. Converted at 916.21 CLP/USD (2026 fx on 2022 CLP: approximate). ATD5 (rural): 545,507 CLP/kW-yr = 595 USD/kW-yr.
ITP PNP 1st half 2027, Tabla 22. SEN range 8.98 (Coopelan) - 12.35 (Colina). Use to value peak-power losses (147.7 USD/kW-yr).
Short-run node price (precio de nudo de corto plazo), Tabla 19. Lower-bound alternative for loss valuation.
Long-duration outage cost (rationing), RE 432/2026. Deeper tranches: 974.80 / 1,135.97 / 1,434.37 USD/MWh.

annuity_rate_note: Real, after taxes; LGSE art. 182 bis band 6-8 %; computed 5.56 % -> floor 6.00 % (Bases RE 221/2023 1.2 d).

lives.note: Bases RE 221/2023 section 6.4 table of agrupaciones. Transformers, capacitors and regulators assumed to fall under 'equipamiento electromecanico y electromagnetico' (30 yr) - mapping not stated explicitly (not verified).

coym_pct_note: Model default: CNE reference COMA 4.70 % of VI (zonal system C, PET 2025), close to VAD ATD1 COyM/VNR 4.6 %. Rural ATDs are much higher (up to ~30 %).
loss_energy_price_note: Average node price (PNP) of the SEN, 1st half 2027 ITP (Tabla 20). VAD bases value losses at the PNP decree price at the distribution entry point, without art. 157 adjustments.
cens_note: CFCD (costo de falla de corta duracion) SEN = 13.73 USD/kWh, RE 432 exenta 17-08-2026. The VAD itself treats quality as an NTD constraint (no ENS cost in the model company); art. 16 B compensations = 2 x ENS at costo de racionamiento. Use CFCD as the ENS penalty proxy; CFLD 795.11 USD/MWh is the long-duration alternative.

quality.note: NTD April 2024, Tabla 3 (95 % of time, 10-min averages, normal state) and Tabla 16.
